conclusion: Rolling dispersion-window reassignment is EXPLORATORY_ONLY: it tests state-construction sensitivity on the already-inspected sealed forward block. No result promotes a hypothesis, unlocks the confirmatory track, or serves as independent confirmation. A genuinely fresh sealed forward block with formations after 2026-09-29 remains required for any confirmatory claim.
decision_rule: ROLLING_ROBUST only if every adequate window (n_high>=5 and n_low>=5) is SIGN_POSITIVE and every such window's 2025-10 leave-one-out delta fraction is within [-0.5, +0.5]; otherwise ROLLING_FRAGILE. All EXPLORATORY_ONLY.
